Our Story

A tote is just fabric until someone gives it a story.

BAGGE started with a simple idea: the bag you carry every day shouldn't be blank. Since 2026 we've been printing cotton canvas totes — fruit, phrases, hearts, and your own words or photos — because what you carry should say something about you.

Every bagge is cut, sewn and hand-printed in small batches, starting at ₹199. No two press runs are identical, which is exactly how we like it.

India's sustainable move

Carry better. Live lighter.

BAGGE is inspired by two Government of India initiatives that connect sustainable everyday choices with stronger local livelihoods.

01 · MISSION LiFE

Lifestyle for Environment

A movement encouraging everyday choices that are kinder to the environment — including choosing reusable cloth and cotton bags over single-use plastics.

Reuse · Reduce · Rethink
02 · PMEGP

Local enterprise, real livelihoods

A credit-linked subsidy programme managed by the Ministry of MSME that supports small-scale enterprises, including cottage businesses in cloth and cotton bag making.

Small business · Big possibility
